description: Plain request for a physician referral before the center will book a new-patient visit.

event.subject: Re: New patient inquiry
event.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out to the Lakeview University Sarcoma Center. We can only schedule new patients who have a written referral from their treating physician. Please have your doctor's office send a referral and we will take it from there.

Regards,
Priya Nandakumar
New Patient Intake

expected.rationale: The center says it needs a written referral from the patient's treating physician before scheduling.
expected.quote: We can only schedule new patients who have a written referral from their treating physician.
